facts.business: TV Vision Limited operates television broadcasting channels and related media business.

auditor.name: M/s. P. Parikh & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: (i) understatement of finance costs by Rs.26.16 crore and liabilities by Rs.195.50 crore due to unrecognized interest on PNB loan; (ii) no provision for diminution in value of investments in subsidiaries (Rs.300 lakh) and associate (Rs.3,012 lakh); (iii) impairment of Business and Commercial Rights of Rs.1,250.39 lakh not provided; (iv) non-provision of interest on late payment of carriage fees and operational costs; (v) no actuarial valuation for leave encashment and gratuity; (vi) no reconciliation of ITC per GSTR-2B. Emphasis of matter on PNB petition under Section 7 of IBC. Material uncertainty related to going concern due to negative total equity of Rs.14,425.49 lakh.

key_risks: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) initiated by Punjab National Bank
Negative total equity of Rs.14,425.49 lakh indicating going concern uncertainty
Unrecognized interest on secured loans leading to understatement of finance costs and liabilities
Impairment of Business and Commercial Rights not provided for
Non-provision for diminution in value of investments in subsidiaries and associate
Non-provision of interest on overdue carriage fees and operational costs
Lack of actuarial valuation for employee benefit obligations
Unreconciled input tax credit differences with GSTR-2B
Trade creditors and loan balances subject to confirmation/reconciliation
